_about: Background prompts. Numbers (horizon, floor line, clear strip, base lines) are computed from config/theme.json by kit/prompt_bg.py, so they follow the build. Edit the words here; run `python3 kit/prompt_bg.py --publish` to rebuild prompts/backgrounds.json and BACKGROUNDS.md.
style: STYLE: clean cartoon video-game illustration that matches a friendly cartoon boy character who will be placed on top: smooth rounded vector-like shapes, flat cel shading with ONE soft shadow tone, vivid saturated but harmonious colors, crisp clean edges. A medium-weight dark outline ONLY on the nearest objects; the farther the object, the thinner the outline, and no outline at all on the farthest shapes. NOT pixel art: no visible pixels, no dithering, no 8-bit, 16-bit or 64-bit look, no noise, no painterly texture, no photo realism.
camera: CAMERA: a low, level, straight-on side view, like a 2.5D side-scrolling game. ONE horizon line {horizon}% down from the top of the image, shared by every layer. No tilt, no wide-angle distortion, no dramatic vanishing points.
stage: THE STAGE (very important): a cartoon boy about {boy_h}% of the image height will be pasted on top, standing with his feet on an invisible line {floor}% down from the top, in the middle. Keep the strip from {strip_top}% to {strip_bottom}% down the image completely flat, smooth and empty (no rocks, plants, lines or shadows bigger than a pebble) so he stands on clean ground. Keep the middle third of the image (left to right) calm, with lower contrast and no strong shapes, so his silhouette reads clearly; put the interest and detail in the left and right thirds. Nothing may rise in front of the stage strip.
light: LIGHT: {light} One light direction in every layer.
depth: DEPTH: objects shrink steadily with distance and every layer sits on the same horizon. Atmospheric perspective: the farther a layer is, the lighter, bluer, simpler and lower in contrast it is (but never blurry: keep the edges crisp); the nearer a layer is, the darker, warmer, more saturated and more detailed.
keying: COLOR RULE: do not use pink, magenta or saturated purple anywhere in the artwork (the magenta background is removed by software). Use blue-grey for haze and distance. All edges crisp: no glow, feathering, blur or airbrushed edges against the background.

lights.morning: bright clear morning, the sun high in the upper left, warm soft light, soft shadows falling slightly to the right and behind objects.
lights.golden: golden evening, the sun low on the left, warm orange-gold light, long soft shadows falling to the right, a warmer sky near the horizon.
lights.overcast: soft overcast day, even cool light, no cast shadows, slightly muted colors, a pale grey-blue sky.

gym_keeper.title: Gym (keeper): finishing pass, portrait version and floor mats
gym_keeper.finish:
Using the attached image as the exact base (a bright cartoon gym with a mid-grey rubber floor), keep EVERYTHING the same except the changes below: same colors, same line weight, same composition, same equipment, plants, lamps and beams. {aspect} ({W}x{H}). No people.

CHANGES:
1. CENTER WINDOW: make the middle of the three windows one plain large pane with no cross bars (or bars so faint they are barely visible), so nothing busy sits behind a character's head. Keep the left and right windows exactly as they are.
2. SUNBEAMS: remove the diagonal sunbeam shadows from the middle third of the wall (keep the warm glow on the left third), so the wall behind the center is calm.
3. FLOOR: keep the mid-grey (about #707680) smooth rubber floor and its faint seams. Keep the strip from {strip_top}% to {strip_bottom}% down completely flat, smooth and empty, and keep the whole middle half of the floor empty. Do not add a mat.
4. Do not move the wall-floor line ({wall_floor}% down).
5. Do not use pink, magenta or saturated purple anywhere.
gym_keeper.portrait_room:
Using the attached wide gym image as the exact reference for the room (same cream wall with a teal band, teal beams, lamps, windows, plants, dumbbell, mat and kettlebell racks, ball, and the same mid-grey rubber floor), create a TALL {aspect} ({W}x{H}) version of the same room for a phone screen. No people.

- The wall-floor line is {wall_floor}% down from the top; a character will stand with his feet on an invisible line {floor}% down, in the middle.
- Keep the strip from {strip_top}% to {strip_bottom}% down completely flat, smooth and empty, and the whole middle of the floor empty. Do not add a mat.
- Keep the middle third of the wall calm: one plain large window or none directly behind the center, no equipment in the middle.
- Put the equipment racks, ball and plants only at the far left and far right edges, a little smaller than in the wide image.
- Same light from the upper left, same style and line weight, no pink, magenta or saturated purple.
gym_keeper.mat:
Using the attached image as the exact reference for the room and its floor perspective, draw ONLY a large rectangular exercise mat lying flat on that floor, as a separate full-frame image: {aspect} ({W}x{H}), exactly the same size and framing as the reference. Everything that is not the mat must be perfectly flat solid magenta (#FF00FF): no background, no room, no floor, no shadow, no gradient.

THE MAT: {name}, about {hex}, with rounded corners, a slightly lighter top surface, a thin lighter border line near the edge (about {border}) and a thin darker front edge (about {edge}) so it has a little thickness. It is completely plain: no logo, no text, no stitching texture, no pattern.
POSITION AND PERSPECTIVE (follow exactly): the near edge of the mat is {mat_bottom}% down from the top and runs from {near_left}% to {near_right}% across; the far edge is {mat_top}% down and runs from {far_left}% to {far_right}%, so it narrows slightly with distance, matching the floor seams in the reference. A character will stand and lie in the middle of the mat with his feet on the line {floor}% down, so keep the top surface perfectly flat and clean.
All edges crisp: no glow, feathering or blur against the magenta. No pink, magenta or saturated purple in the mat itself.

ALSO GIVE ME a second image: the same mat placed on the reference room, as a preview.
